name: Gelati & Peccati
notes: Combined-menu shop (gelateria + pizza-by-the-slice + coffee bar). Own site (Bentobox/SpotOn, spot_id 71305) has two menu pages: drink-menu (Caffetteria/Specialties/Drinks, all priced, used as source here) and food-menu, which lists ONLY gelato flavor names across two sections ('Gelati & Peccati' and 'Others') plus a 'Pizza - Our Philosophy' text blurb -- none of these carry any per-item price, checked in the raw HTML (no $ at all on that page). This matches the ordinary practice of gelaterias pricing by cup/cone SIZE chosen at the register rather than by flavor; no size-based price list was found anywhere (own site, DoorDash, or Grubhub search snippets), so per rule 12 no gelato flavor is recorded. Pizza-by-the-slice and by-the-tray items (not itemized on the restaurant's own site at all) were pulled from DoorDash's server-side schema.org Menu JSON-LD (doordash.com/store/gelati-peccati-san-diego-33079707/), address-verified as 3066 University Ave, San Diego -- matches the work-list address. DoorDash also listed a 'Beverages' (canned soda) section; excluded because it duplicates the own-site Drinks section at differing prices for the San Pellegrino cans ($3.50 own site vs $3.75 DoorDash) -- treated as marketplace markup vs first-party price and the first-party number was kept instead. Grubhub's page for this restaurant returned a JS shell with no usable price data (13KB, no items), so no tier-3 cross-check was obtainable; DoorDash pizza prices are clean round dollar amounts ($6/slice, $26-$30 half tray, $54-$60 full tray) with no markup-ratio pattern, which supports them being real menu prices rather than fee-inflated. Categories reached: own-site drink menu (full), own-site food menu (full, unpriced), DoorDash full item list (full). Categories not reached: none identified as missing beyond the unpriced gelato flavors.
